description.p: Poet Music plays the music that is already on your disk. There is no account, no catalogue and no sign-in: you point it at a folder, it reads the tags, cover art and .lrc lyric files it finds there, and that is your library.

Browsing is by song, album, artist, genre or playlist, with live search and a sort order that is remembered between sessions. Now Playing carries a seek bar, synced lyrics, a ten-band equaliser, playback-speed steps and a sleep timer that can end on a clock or after a set number of songs.

The queue is a working copy rather than an engine setting: shuffling writes a new fixed order around the song currently playing, un-shuffling puts the original order back, and "play next" inserts directly after the current track. The queue, position and modes survive a restart.

ul.li: A tag editor that writes to MP3, FLAC, OGG and M4A, including embedded artwork and lyrics, with a synced-LRC maker that stamps timestamps against live playback.
A Listening Journal reporting on your own archive — totals, top artists and albums, listening habits and library health.
Desktop media controls over MPRIS, so the panel applet and the keyboard media keys drive playback.
Pastel accent colours and canvas tints, in light and dark.

description.p: Playback is the system's GStreamer, so it uses the codecs already installed. The interface is a WebKitGTK view in a GTK window over a server bound to the loopback address only. Nothing is sent anywhere.
Desktop media controls over MPRIS, uninstalling now stops playback, and a redrawn navigation rail.
